name: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Iron Gates Of Love
seoTitle: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows, UMS: Iron Gates Of Love
description: René Moffatt wrote Iron Gates Of Love, and in summer 2026 he played it with his full band at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver. He's a lot louder with the band behind him than he is in his solo sets.
